summary: Two hikers caught in a lightning storm on the Continental Divide near Loveland Pass; rescue team flew a drone with camera and speaker up to the pair to tell them help was coming before rescuers reached them on foot; storm danger led leaders to hold some rescuers back
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group, Alpine Rescue Team
notes: Location straddled the county line so both teams were called; article reports no injuries; outcome listed as assist; third of 'three calls in six days' in the TNS article
